# Navigation Shell (Tier 0)

Implement the immutable 5-tab bottom navigation shell in the Expo app.

Acceptance criteria:
- Bottom tab navigation with Home, Discover, Wardrobe, Shop, Profile implemented using Expo Router or React Navigation.
- Empty placeholder screens for each tab with route names and basic telemetry hooks.
- Modal bottom sheet available for future AI quick actions.

Success metric: All 5 tabs navigable; shell passes smoke test on device.
